caption: A calm lake fills the lower frame, bordered by a black tree-covered hill and a heavily clouded sky. A horizontal row of evenly spaced warm lights spans the waterline, each casting a vertical golden reflection, while a bright light anchors the right edge and a faint green glow sits at the left. Overall luminance climbs steadily and monotonically, the scene lifting from near-black toward dim twilight with no shift in camera angle or object position. As the light rises, the cloud structure resolves, a brighter mass gathering at the upper left. The hill's silhouette softens from pure black into a textured dark-green mass of foliage. Bridge arches beneath the lamps become faintly discernible, and the small green hillside dot and left-edge glow grow slightly more visible. The warm lights and their mirror reflections hold constant in position and color, with only a slight shimmer on the water.
